BiblicalUsage: Ashvath appears once, in the genealogy of Asher, listed among the sons of Japhlet. His name survives only in that family record, as one of the heads counted among Asher's descendants.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept in the record matters even when nothing else is told about the man, because God counts His people one by one.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
